items.name: row
items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn row(account: &AccountRow<'_>) -> crate::translation_core::Text {
    let optional =
        |value: Option<u64>| value.map_or_else(|| "-".to_string(), |value| value.to_string());
    crate::translation_core::format!(
        "{:<16}  {:<8}  {:<12}  {:<6}  {:<9}  {:<9}  {}",
        account.name,
        account
            .healthy
            .map_or_else(|| "-".to_string(), |healthy| healthy.to_string()),
        account.credential,
        optional(account.used),
        optional(account.limit),
        optional(account.remaining),
        account.home
    )
}
